data.headline: Project Manager, MedTech, Customer Delivery Projects | Medtronic Digital Technologies
data.about:
Self-driven, solution and customer oriented project manager with over 10 years' experience in managing large scale international multi-discipline customer delivery projects in MedTech.

Strong skills in project and solution sales, finding an optimal solution with customer, working and communicating proactively with international and multicultural project teams, establishing partnerships, communicating efficiently with broad range of stakeholders, meeting project goals and carrying complete responsibility of complex and extensive medical device delivery projects.

Highly experienced in 2D and 3D layout designing of operating rooms (OR), intensive care units (ICU) and dental hospitals and clinics including technical planning and designing of work, patient and material flows.

description.text:
Project managing full-cycle implementations of Touch Surgery™ Enterprise—Medtronic's award-winning, cloud-based surgical video system with cutting-edge technologies (AI, Machine Learning, Analytics)—at leading hospitals across EMEA and APAC including monitoring the project from initiation through delivery, managing the operational aspects of ongoing projects, ensuring solutions are effectively tailored to meet customer needs and seamlessly integrate into the customer's environment, liaising with internal teams and external stakeholders to guarantee successful project execution and ensuring projects are executed on-time and within budget.

In addition, supporting sales and working in various product development workstreams.

Selling, managing, planning and executing operating room (OR) and intensive care unit (ICU) delivery projects on the Finnish market. The main focus being on project and solution sales, technical planning, 2D and 3D layout designing, establishing and developing partnerships, communicating and co-operating with a broad range of stakeholders and carrying the complete responsibility of complex medical technology projects with the latest innovations. 

In addition working as product manager of Maquet surgical equipment in the Nordic countries. The main focus being on supporting the whole Nordic sales team and communicating with the business area.

Achievements:
- Sold and delivered two first Hybrid ORs on the Finnish market, in addition sold 3 more Hybrid ORs
- Sold and delivered first complete turn-key OR department delivery on the Finnish market
- Sold and delivered first Maquet Variop modular OR system on the Finnish market, in addition sold and planned another one
- Significant growth in OR and ICU project sales on the Finnish market 
- In 2021 OR and ICU project sales' order intake on the Finnish market was over 9M€

Managing, planning, selling and executing international large scale dental university and hospital projects, with primary  focus on:
- carrying the complete responsibility of complex health tech delivery projects,

Planning, managing and implementing of various development projects independently and with a team in automation production, logistics and main assembly of paper finishing machines.
Development projects included planning and development of processes, layout planning of production facilites, Lean projects and planning, testing and developing of IT tools. Largest single development project was planning and implementing of new logistics operating model and logistics center.

Master´s Thesis examined process of assembling a paper finishing machine and suggested solutions of improving it. The study had two main objectives: 1) to describe the paper finishing machine assembly process as accurately as possible and 2) to determine tagets for development in assembly to shorten the lead time and reduce assembly hours. The main focus was in assembly but other operations such as procurement and R&D were also examined from the assembly point of view.
